deterministic_data.verification: Final Workbench assembly is 14/14 ready with zero errors and warnings, including the Factory canonical validator and the persistence check; SqliteStoreRepository carries every one of the 101 StoreRepository operations with the identical signature, plus create_store_schema; the data provider is python_constant_data_v1 from 70_data_provider_closure.json. clock is system_clock_backend/v3 (python_host_clock_v1) under rules.time_source_policy (single_host_source true), decision 26.

Every port operation is carried with the identical signature by SqliteStoreRepository (implementation_obligations). Decision 24 delta reviewed (RunsByStatus.statuses, ShownEffectAttempt). Decision 32 delta reviewed (operation models of run_graph, run_values, sandbox_runner; ExecutionObservation; StoreChange variant RecordDeliveryValuesChange; every sum type discriminated). Decision 33 delta reviewed (NodeConclusion; row models StatusConclusion, ConclusionEffect, WaitReasonRestingStatus, HttpMethodBody). Decision 35 delta reviewed (ShownTrialExecution.executed_by; State 1 M02, M11, M12, M24, M25, M26 texts).

Deterministic constant module (python_constant_data_v1) emitted from 70_data_provider_closure.json: the release ceilings of A20, token length, header sets, sandbox trap lists, manifest suffix, service-id pattern and the four MCP constants of decision 22. No rules or config address repeats a value. Decision 25 delta reviewed. Decision 33 delta reviewed: data_provider_backend version 2; four record_tuple tables keyed by an enumeration and total over it (EXECUTION_STATUS_CONCLUSIONS, NODE_CONCLUSION_EFFECTS, WAIT_REASON_RESTING_STATUSES, HTTP_METHOD_BODIES); the Factory emitter refuses a missing row. Decision 34: A20 rule 3 names the Linux host and the start flow gained the argument checks; nothing this module does changed.

Emitted from 70_persistence_closure.json (persistence_backend/v3, sqlite_sync_v2, transaction external): SqliteStoreRepository carries all 101 StoreRepository operations with identical signatures plus __init__, and create_store_schema; it imports only models. No note is scoped to it, by design. Decision 34: A20 rule 3 names the Linux host and the start flow gained the argument checks; nothing this module does changed.

Decision 32: the inside of an execution — runner text (environment, setrlimit limits, traps by the owner of the path, audit hook and task count, load and call, pre-count, MemoryError), its two arguments (the channel's descriptor number, one JSON configuration whose members are not spelled like data symbols) and the decoding of its one-line JSON messages; both ends of the protocol in one module. Decision 34: A20 rule 3 names the Linux host and the start flow gained the argument checks; nothing this module does changed.

Every repository operation the store notes name exists in store_persistence; positions, minted identities, attempt numbers, relations, paging and spool ceilings match State 5 and decision 23. Decision 34 delta reviewed (open_store checks the database path with os.lstat before sqlite3 opens it, which cannot refuse a link; A18 text unchanged). Decision 35 delta reviewed (empty-field note: fields a change does not carry stay empty until the later change named; Slot/Flow created_at from the creating change; note 158 points to it).
